description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment Mampe, Kesbawa D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 521202
categorisation: This gazette exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing modifications to land parcel records, expunging particulars, excluding life interests from encumbrances, and correcting village names in land title documentation. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters without any government personnel changes or structural modifications.
